ana: Quick sync — we need to lock launch gates for the next console/observability sprint. Major customer asks: per-route cost breakdown, lightweight trace hooks, and improved error grouping. Who can own acceptance criteria?

mike: I can take the trace hooks spec. thinking minimal SDK: two hook points (request_start, request_end) + sample flag.

ruchi: I’ll own the cost breakdown surfaces. goal: per-route + per-model token breakdown for last 7d and realtime 1h view. low-lift: aggregate only, no per-request table at launch.

sam: I’ll drive dashboard UX. propose 3 main cards: latency p50/p95 by route, cost by route, error groups list with sample traces.

nate: for error analytics I can do grouping by stack + prompt signature, and add a quick regression alert. need to confirm retention SLA and cardinality limits.

ana: thanks. important constraints from legal: no raw prompt content in telemetry by default. keep sample-only and redact.

mike: noted. SDK hooks must emit only metadata by default: route_id, model, token_count, trace_id. full prompt only when explicit sample=true and redaction consent.

ana: rough launch acceptance items I’m thinking: 
- Dashboards: top-5 routes, p50/p95 latency, tokens/day, cost/day (7d window)
- Trace hooks: SDK + server-side shim, sample rate config, example integrations (python/ts)
- Cost breakdown: per-route & per-model aggregated, export CSV for finance
- Error analytics: grouping + links to 3 sample traces, regression alert on error rate delta > 50% over baseline
- Privacy: default redact; sampled prompts opt-in only

sam: can we make the dashboard drilldown default to the route timeline (1h/24h/7d)? that’s what customers asked for.

ruchi: yes. storage wise we can pre-aggregate 1h buckets for 7d retention without big cost. need a DATA task to define rollup job. @nate?

nate: I’ll add the rollup job to the data backlog. can we agree on schema? minimal fields: timestamp, route_id, model, token_sum, cost_estimate, error_count, latency_p50, latency_p95.

mike: for the SDK, minimal payload example: 
```json
{
  "route_id": "string",
  "model": "gpt-x",
  "token_count": 42,
  "trace_id": "uuid",
  "event": "request_start"
}
```
server shim will attach latency and error markers at end.

ana: launch gating question: do we need canary rollout for the tracing SDK? some customers will enable it org-wide.

ruchi: yes, must be opt-in per workspace by default. Dedicated customers can opt-in org-wide. Hosted defaults to sampling 0.1% until proven.

sam: UX acceptance: no more than 3 clicks from console home to a trace sample. wireframes by EOW?

mike: will provide example integrations + a test harness to demonstrate <50ms hook overhead.

nate: alerting: default regression alert threshold = 50% relative increase or absolute 0.5% error_rate, whichever triggers first. add mute window for known deploys.

ana: risks: 1) cost estimate accuracy; 2) privacy / prompts leakage; 3) high-cardinality routes causing noisy dashboards. propose mitigations: conservative cost model, redact by default, route sampling and top-K route cap.

mike: agree. also add telemetry quotas per-customer to prevent runaway.

ana: decisions logged: 
1) Minimum launch surface = aggregated dashboards + SDK hooks + cost CSV export + basic error grouping.
2) Privacy: redact prompt by default; sampled prompt opt-in.
3) Rollout: sampling default 0.1% on hosted; org opt-in for higher sampling; Dedicated can enable fully.

ruchi: next steps / owners: 
- ruchi: cost aggregation and quotas (JIRA: OBS-241)
- mike: SDK + shim + perf tests (JIRA: OBS-242)
- sam: dashboard UX + wireframes (JIRA: OBS-243)
- nate: rollups + schema + alerting (JIRA: OBS-244)
- ana: acceptance criteria + release gating doc (JIRA: OBS-245)

ana: can everyone confirm ETA for sprint planning? target: feature-flagged beta in 3 sprints, GA in 8 sprints.

mike: beta in 3 sprints is doable if we scope to top-5 routes + python/ts SDK only.

sam: wireframes by EOW, beta-ready visuals in 2 sprints.

ruchi: rollup job and CSV export ready for beta in 3 sprints, will need infra review.

nate: schema + alerts done in 2 sprints; integration tests in sprint 3.

ana: perfect. I’ll draft the acceptance checklist and runway notes. tagging these as "high" priority for the release board.

ops-bot: Deploy reminder — please add deploy checklist to OBS-245 before QA signoff. :white_check_mark:

ana: thanks team. I’ll post the acceptance doc and invite a short triage tomorrow 9:30am PT. If anyone needs to reprioritize, flag on the release board. :sparkles:
